items.info: Main Panel. Ensure gear down and locked.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Pedestal. Prevents the aircraft from rolling during prep.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Check BAT 1 and 2 above 25.5 V on the indicators before selecting AUTO.
items.label: Battery 1+2

items.info: Overhead Panel. Press only when the green AVAIL light shows, meaning ground power is connected. The white ON light then comes on.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Position 2 turns on the nav and logo lights. The A32NX has only 2 and OFF.
items.label: Nav & Logo Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. APU Master ON, wait at least 3 seconds, then APU START ON. Wait for AVAIL on the ECAM.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Disconnects external ground power once the APU is supplying power.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. APU Bleed ON for packs and engine start.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. All 3 selectors to NAV to align the inertial reference system.
items.label: ADIRS

items.info: Overhead Panel. All fuel pumps ON.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Crew oxygen ON.
items.label: Oxygen Crew Supply

items.info: Overhead Panel. Should not be illuminated, as window heating is auto-managed.
items.label: Probe Window Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify there are no amber lights except GEN FAULT, which is normal with the engines off.
items.label: ELEC Panel

items.info: Overhead Panel. AUTO.
items.label: X-Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify there are no white lights remaining, indicating all switches are in normal positions.
items.label: Overhead Panel

items.info: Overhead Panel. ARM.
items.label: Emergency Exit Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. No Smoking signs.
items.label: No Smoking

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign ON.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Pedestal. Program the MCDU with your aircraft information and flight plan.
items.label: MCDU Preflight

items.info: Glareshield. EFIS and standby barometric reference set to the local QNH.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Glareshield. Flight directors ON.
items.label: Flight Directors

items.info: Glareshield. Set ND range, mode, and lighting as required for departure.
items.label: EFIS Modes

items.info: Glareshield. Both should show dashes, indicating managed mode for speed and heading.
items.label: FCU SPD/HDG

items.info: Glareshield. Set the initial cleared altitude provided by ATC.
items.label: FCU Altitude

items.info: Main Panel. Check the standby airspeed indicator, altimeter, and artificial horizon.
items.label: Standby Instruments

items.info: Pedestal. Verify full range of movement, then set to IDLE. Recalibrate in the EFB if needed.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Pedestal. Verify both engine master switches OFF before start.
items.label: Engine Masters

items.info: Pedestal. Verify the engine mode selector is in the NORM position.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Pedestal. Weather radar OFF at gate.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Pedestal. Predictive Windshear — enable before takeoff.
items.label: PRED W/S

items.info: Pedestal. Set the squawk code, system 1 and ALT RPTG ON. The mode stays on STBY until lineup.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Pedestal. TCAS STBY at gate.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Main Panel. On the lower ECAM DOOR page, check all doors are closed and the slides are armed.
items.label: Doors

items.info: Main Panel. Ensure the sliding flight deck windows are securely closed.
items.label: Windows

items.info: Overhead Panel. Beacon ON before engine start.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Pedestal. Confirm thrust levers are physically in the IDLE detent.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Prevents the aircraft from rolling during prep.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Main Panel. Cross-check the total fuel on board with the MCDU INIT page 2.
items.label: Fuel On Board

items.info: Pedestal. Crosscheck takeoff speeds and performance data in the MCDU.
items.label: MCDU Takeoff Data

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify APU bleed is active for engine start.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Pedestal. Rotate the engine mode selector to the IGN/START position.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Pedestal. Engine 1 starts first, as current Airbus procedure calls for. Some airlines start engine 2 first.
items.label: Engine Master 1

items.info: Main Panel. The start takes about 1 minute. Stabilized at ISA sea level: N1 ~19%, N2 ~68%, EGT ~520°C, FF ~290 kg/h, and N1 shows AVAIL.
items.label: Engine 1 Parameters

items.info: Pedestal. Start engine 2 once engine 1 is stabilized.
items.label: Engine Master 2

items.info: Main Panel. Same as engine 1. Stabilized at ISA sea level: N1 ~19%, N2 ~68%, EGT ~520°C, FF ~290 kg/h.
items.label: Engine 2 Parameters

items.info: Pedestal. Return to NORM after both engines stable.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Overhead Panel. APU bleed OFF once the engines are running. All engine bleed valves then open automatically.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Shut down APU.
items.label: APU Master

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on engine anti-ice if icing conditions exist on the ground.
items.label: Engine Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. On the ground, wing anti-ice runs only a 30-second test, then the valves close.
items.label: Wing Anti-Ice

items.info: Pedestal. Arm the ground spoilers for rejected takeoff protection.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Pedestal. Flaps 1 for standard takeoff. Flaps 2 or 3 for short runways.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Pedestal. Set pitch trim per the MCDU PERF takeoff page.
items.label: Pitch Trim

items.info: Pedestal. Verify the rudder trim is set to zero.
items.label: Rudder Trim

items.info: Main Panel. Set autobrake to MAX for maximum braking during a rejected takeoff.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Main Panel. Check for full and free movement of the elevator, ailerons, and rudder on the ECAM F-CTL page.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: Main Panel. Ensure there are no status reminders on the upper ECAM display.
items.label: ECAM

items.info: Pedestal. Position 1 turns on radar system 1. The sim shows precipitation only.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Pedestal. Predictive Windshear AUTO.
items.label: PRED W/S

items.info: Main Panel. Turn on the terrain display on the ND to monitor surrounding topography.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Overhead Panel. Set the nose wheel light to TAXI.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. RWY turnoff lights ON as required.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Set strobe lights to AUTO so they activate upon weight-off-wheels.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Pedestal. Release parking brake.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Pedestal. Check brakes during initial taxi. Max taxi speed is 30 kts, turn at ~10 kts.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turning the packs OFF improves takeoff performance with TOGA thrust. Otherwise, leave ON.
items.label: Packs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Ensure engine anti-ice is appropriately set for the weather.
items.label: Engine Anti-Ice

items.info: Pedestal. Select IGN if water is on the runway or heavy rain is expected after takeoff.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Center Pedestal. Predictive windshear system. Set to AUTO for departure so it alerts you to wind shear on the runway and during climb.
items.label: PRED W/S

items.info: Pedestal. Press the T.O CONFIG button on the ECAM to verify there are no configuration warnings.
items.label: T.O Config

items.info: Pedestal. AUTO makes the transponder reply in flight. TCAS works only when the transponder is out of STBY.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Main Panel. Verify the flight controls check was completed.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: Main Panel. Final check of airspeed, altimeter, and heading indicators.
items.label: Flight Instruments

items.info: Main Panel. Verify the 'TAKE OFF NO BLUE' memo on the upper ECAM.
items.label: ECAM Memo

items.info: Overhead Panel. Set the nose light to T.O., which turns on both the taxi and takeoff lights.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Landing lights ON.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Strobes ON at runway entry.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Pedestal. Set TCAS to TA/RA to enable traffic alerts and resolution advisories.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Pedestal. Set 50% N1, release brakes, then advance to FLEX or TOGA detent. Verify N1 command is reached before 80 kts.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Main Panel. Verify the Flight Mode Annunciator shows MAN FLEX or MAN TOGA, SRS, and RWY.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Sidestick. Smoothly rotate at ~3°/sec to a maximum pitch of ~15°. Follow the SRS flight director bars after lift-off.
items.label: Rotate

items.info: Main Panel. Confirm a positive rate of climb, then retract the landing gear.
items.label: Positive Climb

items.info: Pedestal. Disarm the ground spoilers after liftoff.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Main Panel. Verify the landing gear indicators show UP and locked.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Pedestal. Set thrust levers to the CL (Climb) detent at the thrust reduction altitude when LVR CLB flashes in the FMA.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Glareshield. Press AP1 on the FCU once the thrust levers are in CL. The FMA shows AP1 in white at the top right.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn packs ON if previously set to OFF for takeoff. Wait at least 10 seconds between starting Pack 1 and Pack 2.
items.label: Packs

items.info: Pedestal. Retract Flaps 1 at 'F' speed, and Flaps 0 at 'S' speed as indicated on the PFD.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Set to OFF after flap retraction. The light goes off by itself when the gear retracts, and the switch covers a failed auto-off.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Set to OFF after flap retraction. Like the nose light, it goes off by itself when the gear retracts.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on engine anti-ice if flying through visible moisture below 10°C.
items.label: Engine Anti-Ice

items.info: Pedestal. Adjust engine mode selector as required for current weather.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Glareshield. Set altimeters to standard (1013 hPa / 29.92 inHg) when passing the transition altitude. Include the standby altimeter.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Overhead Panel. Passing 10,000 ft. RETRACT stows the lights. OFF leaves them extended under the wings, where they add drag.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Main Panel. Terrain on ND OFF.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign off if smooth above 10,000 ft.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Main Panel. Verify the correct autopilot and autothrust modes are engaged on the FMA.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Main Panel. Verify the landing elevation is set to AUTO on the ECAM PRESS page.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: Overhead Panel. Monitor outside air temperature and visible moisture, applying anti-ice as needed.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Main Panel. Monitor fuel consumption, wind, and time estimates on the MCDU flight plan page.
items.label: Flight Plan

items.info: Pedestal. Crosscheck top of descent. Rule of thumb: (CRZ ALT - DEST ALT) / 1000 x 3 = TOD in NM.
items.label: TOD

items.info: Main Panel. Verify LDG ELEV AUTO on the ECAM Cruise page.
items.label: ECAM Cruise Page

items.info: Radio Panel. Obtain ATIS or airport weather for runway, wind, altimeter, and temperature.
items.label: Landing Info

items.info: Pedestal. F-PLN: verify/set STAR and approach. PERF APPR: QNH, temp, wind, TRANS FL, minimums.
items.label: MCDU Approach

items.info: Main Panel. Set to LO or MED as required for runway length and conditions.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Apply anti-ice if descending through icing conditions.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign ON.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Glareshield. Set 3000 ft or the proper procedure altitude on the FCU. Do not initiate descent yet.
items.label: FCU Altitude

items.info: Glareshield. Start the descent at top of descent, once ATC clears you. Push for managed descent (DES), which respects altitude constraints. Pull for open descent (OP DES), a steadier descent that ignores them.
items.label: FCU ALT Knob

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on engine anti-ice if passing through visible moisture.
items.label: Engine Anti-Ice

items.info: Pedestal. Set engine mode to IGN if heavy rain or turbulence is expected.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on the landing lights when descending below 10,000 feet.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Main Panel. Turn on the terrain display on the ND to monitor surrounding ground elevation.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Glareshield. Press the CSTR button to show altitude and speed constraints on the ND.
items.label: EFIS

items.info: Glareshield. Press the LS button to display localizer and glideslope scales on the PFD.
items.label: LS Button

items.info: Glareshield. At the transition level, set altimeters to the local QNH. Include the standby altimeter.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Main Panel. Confirm the LS button is active and scales are visible on the PFD.
items.label: LS Button

items.info: Pedestal. Select IGN on the engine mode selector if precipitation or icing conditions exist.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Main Panel. Verify the autobrake is set to the desired level.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Glareshield. Verify the local QNH is set on all altimeters, including standby.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Main Panel. Verify minimums are entered in the MCDU PERF approach page.
items.label: Minimums

items.info: Pedestal. TA/RA is the normal setting. Use TA only where RAs are inappropriate, such as converging or parallel runways.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Pedestal. Verify the approach phase is active in the MCDU to enable approach speeds.
items.label: MCDU Approach Phase

items.info: Pedestal. Select Flaps 1 at ~15 NM or when speed allows. Verify the green dot speed on the PFD.
items.label: Flaps 1

items.info: Glareshield. Press APPR on the FCU when cleared for the approach and on an intercept path to the localizer. LOC and G/S show in blue on the FMA, and the aircraft descends once it captures the glideslope.
items.label: APPR

items.info: Glareshield. Engage AP2 alongside AP1 once APPR is armed, for redundancy on the approach.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Pedestal. Select Flaps 2 when intercepting the glideslope or at ~2000 ft AGL.
items.label: Flaps 2

items.info: Main Panel. Lower the landing gear at the glideslope intercept or 2000 ft AGL. Verify 3 green lights.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Pedestal. Arm the ground spoilers for automatic deployment upon touchdown.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Overhead Panel. Set the nose light to T.O. once the gear is down.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Pedestal. Select Flaps 3 as the speed continues to decrease.
items.label: Flaps 3

items.info: Pedestal. Select Flaps Full for the final landing configuration.
items.label: Flaps Full

items.info: Glareshield. Disengage the autopilot for a manual landing, typically by 400 ft AGL. Leave engaged for an autoland.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Sidestick. Slowly raise the nose to flare at ~30 ft. Hold the attitude and let the speed bleed off.
items.label: Flare

items.info: Pedestal. After starting the flare, retard to IDLE at the RETARD callout, around 10-20 ft.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Pedestal. Select reverse right after the main gear touches down. Back to REV IDLE at 70 kts, and stow the reversers at taxi speed.
items.label: Reverse Thrust

items.info: Pedestal. Monitor autobrake or apply manual braking. Disengage autopilot after rollout if an autoland was performed.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Pedestal. Disarm the ground spoilers as they retract automatically.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Pedestal. Retract the flaps fully after clearing the active runway.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Strobes OFF after clearing the runway.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Retract the landing lights after landing.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Set the nose wheel light to TAXI.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. RWY turnoff lights ON for night taxiing.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: Glareshield. Flight directors OFF.
items.label: Flight Directors

items.info: Glareshield. LS button OFF.
items.label: LS Button

items.info: Main Panel. Terrain on ND OFF.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Pedestal. Weather radar OFF.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Pedestal. PRED W/S OFF.
items.label: PRED W/S

items.info: Pedestal. Transponder STBY.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Pedestal. TCAS STBY.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Main Panel. Autobrake OFF.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Start APU at gate.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off anti-ice systems unless required by ground conditions.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Main Panel. Check brake temperatures on the ECAM wheel page. Use brake fans if installed and temperatures are high.
items.label: Brake Temperature

items.info: Pedestal. Keep the parking brake set, or release if chocks are confirmed in place.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Nose light OFF.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off all anti-ice systems.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. APU takes over pneumatic supply before engines shut down.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Pedestal. Turn off both engine master switches to shut down the engines.
items.label: Engine Master 1+2

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign OFF.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Overhead Panel. Beacon OFF once engines are spooled down.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Overhead Panel. Fuel pumps OFF.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Pedestal. The mode selector has no OFF. STBY keeps the transponder powered but not replying.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Pedestal. Keep the parking brake set.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Crew oxygen OFF.
items.label: Oxygen Crew Supply

items.info: Overhead Panel. ADIRS all OFF.
items.label: ADIRS

items.info: Overhead Panel. Exterior lights OFF.
items.label: Exterior Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. APU Bleed OFF before APU Master.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. APU Master OFF. Wait 2 minutes for the APU flap door to close before turning off the batteries, as closing it needs APU or external power.
items.label: APU Master

items.info: Overhead Panel. Emergency exit lights OFF.
items.label: Emergency Exit Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. No smoking signs OFF.
items.label: No Smoking

items.info: Overhead Panel. Batteries OFF — aircraft fully de-powered.
items.label: Battery 1+2

description: The modern, narrow-body standard of efficiency, featuring advanced fly-by-wire precision and a signature sidestick design.
variant: It's the free A32NX. Other A320 add-ons, such as Fenix's, differ in places.
